info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Systems Assurance Assessment Submission API
info.description: The Systems Assurance Assessment Submission API allows businesses to submit assessments related to IT management systems assurance. This API streamlines the process of assessment creation, enabling users to efficiently document and manage their evaluations within the banking sector. Typical consumers of this API include IT managers and compliance officers who need to ensure systems meet regulatory and operational standards. By providing a structured submission process, the API supports organizations in maintaining high levels of assurance and continuous improvement.

post.summary: Create a new Systems Assurance Assessment.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new assessment within the Systems Assurance framework of IT Management. Use this API to submit necessary data for the assessment and receive confirmation of its successful creation.

requestBody.description: This request body is designed to submit a new assessment in the systems assurance management section. The payload should contain all necessary information required to create the assessment, adhering to the schema defined for this operation.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the assessment data is returned.

CreateSystemsAssuranceAssessmentRequest.title: Systems Assurance Request Body

systemId.description: Identifier for the system being assessed.

environment.description: Deployment environment of the system (e.g., production, staging).

changeId.description: Identifier for the change related to this assessment.

plannedAt.description: Planned date and time for the assessment in ISO 8601 format.

serviceTier.description: Service tier of the system (e.g., Gold, Silver, Bronze).

availabilityTargetPercent.description: Target availability percentage for the system.

maintenanceWindow.description: Scheduled maintenance window for the system in ISO 8601 format.

CreateSystemsAssuranceAssessmentRequest.description: Request body for creating a systems assurance assessment.

correlationId.description: Identifier for correlating logs and requests.

idempotencyKey.description: Key to ensure that the request is idempotent.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp when the request was made in ISO 8601 format.

sourceApplication.description: Identifier for the application that initiated the request.

channel.description: Information about the channel through which the request was made.

systemId.description: The unique identifier of the system being assessed.

changeId.description: The unique identifier for the change related to this assessment.

assessmentId.description: The unique identifier for the assessment.

CreateSystemsAssuranceAssessmentResponse.description: Schema representing the response of an assessment for a system.
